body.message:
Please note that, as today is a weekend and the payment has been made via bank transfer, we will need to receive confirmation from our Finance Department. Unfortunately, we will only be able to obtain the confirmation by tomorrow.

However, as you have shared the payment proof with us for the 1-night extension, we are happy to proceed with extending your stay for an additional 7 nights, subject to the payment confirmation. Your revised check-out date will be 12 September.

Payment link for the extension:

https://totalpay.ae/payment/20260906506a9d41528b5f7

Once the payment has been completed, could you kindly confirm with us so that we can proceed with the extension arrangements accordingly?
